Claude Code now runs on Opus 5.5
Claude Opus 5.5 is the default model in Claude Code on your Max plan. It performs at the level of Fable 5.1 on most work, and it’s ~30% faster and ~40% cheaper than Opus 5 per task.
It’s a lot better at writing too. It’s clearer, uses less jargon, and follows the writing rules you give it.
Opus 5.5 is priced lower than Opus 5, so your usage limits go about 25% further. We’re also raising Pro and Max users’ 5-hour limit by 20%.
Effort starts at medium, which is a good balance for most work. Run /effort to raise it for harder tasks. To see it in action, watch Lydia from the Claude Code team show how she uses Opus 5.5 as her daily driver. Then try it on a repo you know:
       
Claude Code
Opus 5.5 · ~/your-project
> Read this codebase and find the slowest test in the suite. Explain why it’s slow and propose a fix before you edit anything.
Opus 5.5 · medium effort
Try this prompt →
 
You have a limit reset
You have one limit reset* to use any time before October 22 at 9 am PT. It refills your 5-hour and weekly limits. To use your limit reset, go to Settings → Usage on the web or in Claude Desktop.
Use your reset →
 
What Opus 5.5 means for your limits
• How far do my limits go? Limits go about 25% further on Opus 5.5 than on Opus 5.
• Did my limits change? 5-hour limits are 20% higher on every model. Weekly limits aren’t changing.
